test.doc: Full end-to-end happy path: new user, salaried employment, Parent/Guardian applicant type. Uses fixed APP_* stub data. Mobile is auto-generated (new account each run).

suite.doc:
Smoke E2E test — single fixed happy-path run of the full application creation journey. Login → Dashboard → Student Details → Choose Plan → Select Applicant → Basic Details → Onboarding → Personal Details → Residential Details → Employment (Salaried) → Confirm Application → Assert Success.
Uses a randomly generated mobile (new account per run). Fixed stub data from APP_* variables in variables.robot.
Run: ./env/bin/robot --outputdir results/ tests/e2e/smoke_e2e_tests.robot
Tags: e2e, smoke
